import novamind_api as nm

# === PRICING: ratchet B (+15, churn 0.75% safe, WTP$178), probe C (+8, 0 churn), hold A ===
print("set_prices:", nm.pricing.set_prices(A=20, B=115, C=186))

# === ADS: scale engine, probe content saturation. ALL S2 (full map replace) ===
ad = nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S2": 4500},
    "social_media":      {"S2": 850},
    "linkedin":          {"S2": 750},
    "referral_program":  {"S2": 500},
})
print("ads total/day:", ad)

# === OPS/DEV: global ops 1200->1300, dev 300 hold; targeted S2 ops 600->800, dev 1500 hold ===
print("daily_spend(global):", nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1300, development=300))
print("targeted ops:", nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 800}))
print("targeted dev:", nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 1500}))

# === LEAD PROMO: scale with B price to hold new-lead eval ~$44 (B$115 - $71off) ===
print("lead promo:", nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=5.0, by_group={"S1": 5.0, "S2": 66.0}))

# === VERIFY: S2 usage distribution (quota question: any near 8000 B-quota?) ===
r = nm.query("SELECT du.usage_units AS u FROM daily_usage du JOIN customers c ON du.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND du.day=125 ORDER BY du.usage_units DESC LIMIT 8")
print("S2 TOP usage day125:", [round(row['u'],1) for row in r['rows']])
r2 = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(du.usage_units) AS mx, AVG(du.usage_units) AS av FROM daily_usage du JOIN customers c ON du.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND du.day=125")
print("S2 usage day125 n/max/avg:", r2['rows'])
r3 = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM daily_usage du JOIN customers c ON du.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND du.day=125 AND du.usage_units>4000")
print("S2 subs >4000 usage:", r3['rows'])
